Responsibilities:
In this role, you will:

Conduct technical audits, crawl/log-file analyses, and manage indexation (noindex, canonicals, robots.txt) to resolve issues on a platform with large URL volumes.
Strategically advance our Entity Optimization and Semantic Search capabilities through structured data (Schema.org) and internal linking to build a machine-readable Knowledge Graph.
Drive the technical readiness of the platform for generative search engines (GEO) and AI-powered answers (AIO), including managing AI crawlers.
Build and automate internal tools, apps, and monitoring workflows using an AI-first approach with tools like Claude, Lovable, v0, Cursor, and n8n.
Establish workflows to measure and analyze our visibility within AI answers and translate SEO goals into actionable technical requirements for Product & Tech teams.


 Your Profile:
We're looking for someone with deep experience in technical SEO for large-scale websites, who has a proven ability to leverage AI and automation to create scalable systems.

Proven experience working with Screaming Frog, GSC, Ahrefs/SISTRIX/SEMrush; HTML/CSS, JS rendering, Schema.org;
Deep understanding of entity-based search and Knowledge Graphs; AI-first building with LLMs (Claude, Lovable, etc.).
Nice to have: Dashboarding, database experience, programmatic SEO, and experience building agent/tooling infrastructures (n8n).
Experience isolating platform-wide patterns and algorithmic anomalies across all markets, distinguishing business impact from digital noise.
Systematically dissects root causes when algorithms change, finding creative workarounds where standard tools reach their limits.
Experience translating highly complex technical SEO dependencies into clear business value for Product Owners and developers.
Independently identifies and prioritizes high-impact actions and documents workflows to ensure team resilience.

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Samsara is looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Cloud Governance Platform team. This team builds the foundational platforms that enforce governance, identity security, compliance, and software supply-chain protections across all of Samsara's cloud infrastructure and developer environments.
Rather than relying on manual reviews or policy enforcement, this team delivers secure, compliant-by-default systems through cloud IAM guardrails, automated controls, and scalable platform abstractions across AWS and GCP.
As a Senior Engineer you will contribute hands-on to systems that need to be reliable and secure at scale, taking ownership of your components end-to-end.
You will bring strong engineering judgment to design discussions, while looking to senior/staff engineers and your manager for guidance on cross-team tradeoffs.
You should apply if:

Design and build core components of Samsara's Cloud Governance Platform, contributing hands-on to cloud IAM, security controls, compliance enforcement, and software supply-chain security capabilities.
Contribute to the roadmap for governance and security tooling across AWS and GCP, bringing engineering judgment to prioritization discussions.
Translate regulatory and compliance requirements into automated, continuously enforced controls through direct implementation.
Build and maintain software supply-chain security tooling, including SAST, DAST, and secure CI/CD pipeline patterns.
Collaborate with Infrastructure, Security, Compliance, and Product Engineering teams to implement solutions for cross-functional risk and governance problems.
Share technical knowledge with teammates through code reviews, pairing, and day-to-day collaboration.
Clearly communicate technical approach, tradeoffs, and risks in design docs and team discussions.

4+ years of industry experience in software development.

Strong programming/coding and design fundamentals (Golang, Python or similar).

Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM systems, threat models, and mitigations.
Experience designing and operating highly reliable, scalable distributed systems.
Strong communication skills and ability to influence without direct authority.

Experience building internal developer platforms or governance systems used across many teams.
Background in developer tools, infrastructure, or productivity engineering.

WELLHUB:  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

Our offices are in Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Portugal, Romania, Spain, and the UK. You can work from any office or remotely based in any of these countries.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

title: Freelance Sports Production Manager (f/m/x) – 360° Immersive
description_clean:
Your mission
As a Freelance Sports Production Manager (360° Immersive), you are responsible for planning, steering and operationally delivering immersive sports productions at L1VE – from the first project outline to successful on-site execution. The role is remote-first within Europe, with regular on-site presence at productions and optional use of our Berlin office.
Your focus is to manage clear, reliable production processes across departments. You combine strong operational execution with a sharp eye for quality, budget and timing. You understand how live sports productions work – and you make sure they are not only running, but delivered at an excellent level: every time, under new conditions, in new venues, with new requirements.
As a freelancer, you typically support one or several productions in parallel, depending on project scope and timelines.
Your Responsibilities

Own the planning, coordination and on-site execution of immersive sports productions – from site visits and briefings to detailed production planning and delivery on location.
Take end-to-end responsibility across the full production lifecycle: timelines, budgets, quality standards and smooth operations are in your hands.
Coordinate and lead cross-functional teams across Tech, Content & Creation, Brand Partnerships and Post-Production under your project responsibility.
Oversee production logistics, resource planning and crew scheduling in close collaboration with the Tech department and the Production Assistant.
Create, manage and monitor project budgets – you track costs closely and act early when things start to drift.
Identify risks early and develop pragmatic solutions – you remain calm, clear and action-oriented in dynamic, time-critical production environments.
Lead and support production teams on site through clear, appreciative and solution-focused communication – even when the pressure is high.
Work closely with internal stakeholders as an external partner, ensuring transparency on timelines, costs and dependencies across multiple parallel projects where needed.

Your profile
Experience & Expertise

At least 3 years of professional experience in sports production, broadcast production or live event production – you have independently delivered real live productions.
Proven experience in budget planning and budget ownership for production projects – you understand the gap between planned and actual budget and know how to close it.
Experience managing complex projects with multiple internal and external stakeholders – you keep all threads together without losing the overview.
Solid experience in production planning and control – from first cost estimates and robust timelines to final reconciliation with clear ownership.
Familiarity with PM and production tools (e.g. Notion, Asana, Google Workspace or industry-specific production software) – you use tools to create transparency, structure and control.
Strong understanding of the specifics of live sports environments: last-minute changes, high-pressure situations, many parallel dependencies – and how to deliver reliably despite them.
Ideally, prior experience working in a freelance or project-based setup, coordinating multiple clients or productions.

Personal Skills & Mindset

Strong hands-on mentality and high drive to execute – you don’t just talk, you deliver.
High stress resilience – you stay clear, solution-oriented and reliable when the heat is on.
Strong sense of ownership – you take responsibility and don’t pass it on when things get difficult.
Passion for sports and immersive entertainment – you don’t just want to manage productions, you want to actively shape the future of live experiences.
Empathy and excellent communication skills – you lead teams in an appreciative way through clear, structured and reliable communication.
Flexibility and willingness to work on weekends and evenings on site – live sports doesn’t follow a 9-to-5 schedule.

Qualifications

Degree or vocational training in Sports Management, Media/Event Production, Broadcast or a related field – or an equivalent qualification through proven hands-on experience in live sports production.
You are set up as a freelancer (self-employed) and can collaborate with L1VE on a project basis across multiple productions.
Very good English skills (at least fluent, ideally C1 level), written and spoken, – you communicate confidently with international production teams, partners and clients. German basic skills and additional languages are a plus.
Willingness to travel at least 50% of your time – you like to be where the production happens, not just in the office.

Why us?

The opportunity to shape immersive sports productions and production structures in an international, fast-growing tech and media company.
Close collaboration with interdisciplinary teams across Tech, Content & Creation, Brand Partnerships and Post-Production – from first concept to live delivery in the stadium.
Direct impact on innovative live formats, international productions and global sports partnerships.
Work with state-of-the-art 12K/3D/360° streaming technology and immersive platforms that redefine the live experience.
Flexible, freelance, project-based collaboration with the possibility to support one or several productions in parallel, depending on scope and availability.
Modern tools and a culture that values ownership, performance, innovation and bold ideas – on and off the field.
We offer a competitive freelance compensation depending on experience and project scope.

title: Head of Customer Support (m/w/d)
description_clean:
Für Menschen, die Service nicht verwalten, sondern prägen.
Support wird oft unterschätzt.
Dabei entscheidet genau dieser Moment darüber, wie sich eine Zusammenarbeit anfühlt. Wenn etwas nicht funktioniert. Wenn eine Frage auftaucht. Wenn ein Hotel einfach jemanden braucht, der zuhört, versteht und eine Lösung findet.
Genau dort beginnt unsere Arbeit.
Wir sind HotelNetSolutions aus Berlin. Seit 2006 entwickeln wir Software für die Hotellerie. Keine Software von der Stange, sondern Lösungen, die sich den Hotels anpassen und nicht umgekehrt. Mit OnePageBooking, VoucherBooking, RateDistributor und der MultiPropertyView unterstützen wir heute mehr als 2.200 Hotels und Hotelgruppen dabei, mehr Direktbuchungen zu erzielen und ihre Persönlichkeit auch im Internet erlebbar zu machen.
Wir glauben nicht an anonyme Tickets. Wir glauben an Beziehungen. An Erreichbarkeit. An das gesprochene Wort. Und daran, dass guter Support weit mehr ist als die Antwort auf eine Frage.
Deshalb suchen wir keinen Verwalter.
Wir suchen einen Head of Customer Support, der Menschen entwickelt, Prozesse hinterfragt und gemeinsam mit seinem Team dafür sorgt, dass aus jedem Kontakt ein gutes Gefühl entsteht.
Aufgaben

Du führst unser internationales Customer Support Team mit Klarheit, Vertrauen und einem offenen Ohr. Du schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem Menschen gerne Verantwortung übernehmen und ihr Wissen miteinander teilen.
Du erkennst, wo Prozesse haken, bevor sie zum Problem werden. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team entwickelst du unseren Support kontinuierlich weiter und sorgst dafür, dass Qualität kein Zufall ist.
Du behältst Kennzahlen im Blick, ohne dabei den Menschen dahinter zu vergessen. Denn jede Zahl erzählt eine Geschichte. Man muss nur genau hinsehen.
Du arbeitest eng mit Produktmanagement, Entwicklung und Vertrieb zusammen. Kundenfeedback landet bei dir nicht in einer Schublade, sondern dort, wo Produkte besser werden.
Auch wenn es einmal kompliziert wird, bleibst du ruhig. Du begleitest Eskalationen mit Souveränität und findest Lösungen, die langfristig tragen.

Qualifikation

Du hast bereits ein Customer Support oder Customer Success Team geführt und weißt, dass gute Führung nicht bedeutet, auf jede Frage selbst die Antwort zu kennen.
Du hast Freude daran, Menschen wachsen zu sehen und ihnen den Rücken freizuhalten.
Idealerweise kennst du die Hotellerie oder ein Softwareunternehmen, das erklärungsbedürftige Produkte betreut. Du verstehst, wie wichtig verlässlicher Support für den Alltag unserer Kunden ist.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, denkst analytisch und triffst Entscheidungen mit Ruhe und Augenmaß.
Du kommunizierst klar, wertschätzend und verbindlich. Auf Deutsch mindestens auf C1 Niveau. Englisch hilft dir im internationalen Austausch.
Vor allem aber hast du Lust, Dinge besser zu machen. Nicht weil es im Prozesshandbuch steht, sondern weil du weißt, dass guter Service den Unterschied macht.

Benefits
Ein guter Support entsteht nicht durch Prozesse allein.
Er entsteht durch Menschen, die sich gegenseitig vertrauen. Die gerne zusammenarbeiten. Die auch an stressigen Tagen miteinander lachen. Genau so arbeiten wir.
Dich erwartet ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt, Wissen teilt und gemeinsam Lösungen findet. Ehrlich gesagt finden wir sogar, dass es das beste Team aller Zeiten ist. Wahrscheinlich sagen das viele. Wir meinen es wirklich.
Wir suchen Menschen, die bleiben möchten. Deshalb erhältst du einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag und eine langfristige Perspektive in einem inhabergeführten Unternehmen, in dem Zuverlässigkeit nicht nur auf der Website steht, sondern gelebt wird.
Treue soll sich lohnen. Deshalb wächst mit der Zeit auch dein Urlaubsanspruch.
Nach Feierabend ist Feierabend. Unsere Arbeitszeiten sind montags bis freitags geregelt. Überstunden kannst du in Freizeit umwandeln. Das Wochenende gehört dir.
Zwei Tage Home Office. Drei Tage gemeinsam im Büro. Für uns die richtige Mischung aus konzentriertem Arbeiten und persönlichem Austausch.
Unser Berliner Loft im Tiergarten hat den Charme eines echten Hinterhofs. Keine Hochglanzbüros. Dafür kurze Wege, offene Türen und Menschen, die man gerne trifft.
Dresscode? Komm so, wie du dich wohlfühlst. Hoodie funktioniert bei uns genauso gut wie Hemd.
Mitreden gehört bei uns dazu. Bei großen Entscheidungen genauso wie bei der Frage, welche Süßigkeiten als Nächstes im Büro landen.
Und weil Zusammenarbeit mehr ist als Meetings, verbringen wir auch außerhalb des Arbeitsalltags gerne Zeit miteinander. Mal auf der Spree. Mal beim Bowling. Und manchmal einfach bei unserer inzwischen legendären Kuchenparty.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Accounts
description_clean:
In the Global Bank tribe, we're building the infrastructure to provide merchants with a digital business account that empowers them to manage their banking needs. Our goal is to become the most popular banking partner for small merchants globally with an effortless, simple, and affordable experience.
You'll help us transition from fragmented regional setups to a unified global infrastructure, directly enabling millions of merchants worldwide to access seamless banking tailored to their needs.
As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Global Accounts team, you'll own critical pieces of our bank account platform. You'll help us design and build a fully distributed, event-driven system designed to scale across regions with resilience and compliance built in.
You'll work primarily in Kotlin, with opportunities in Elixir and Golang. We practice Extreme Programming: small iterations, daily deliveries, and a focus on technical design quality and deep problem understanding.
Our tech stack includes Kotlin, Golang, Elixir, Java, AWS, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and Kubernetes, supported by observability tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and Honeycomb. We also use AI-assisted development tools including Cursor and GitHub Copilot.
What You'll Do

Build critical infrastructure from scratch: Contribute to the design and implementation of a newly architected global accounts platform. You'll help migrate existing systems to a modern, event-driven, decoupled architecture that enables scalability and resilience across regions.
Master event-driven architecture: You'll be working extensively with Kafka to build a truly decoupled, resilient system. Event-driven architecture is essential to our goal of ensuring that failures in one part of the system don't bring down banking operations globally. This isn't just a technical requirement—it's the foundation of building a platform that can handle the complexities of multi-region banking.
Solve complex compliance challenges: Design flexible systems that handle varying regulatory and verification requirements across different regions and use cases. You'll make compliance requirements maintainable and natural rather than an afterthought.
Enable other teams: Build a self-service platform that empowers internal teams across the organization to contribute to and build on top of.
Work globally: Your work will directly impact EU and LATAM markets, with potential US expansion on the horizon.

You'll Be Great for This Role If

Strong technical foundation: Solid backend development experience in Kotlin, with interest in working across multiple languages (Golang, Elixir). You understand system architecture, object-oriented and functional design principles, data modeling, and API design (RESTful and event-driven).
Event-driven architecture expertise: Proven experience with Kafka and event-driven systems. You understand how this enables true decoupling and resilience in distributed systems.

Ownership and craft: You take full ownership of the software you ship, from design to production readiness. You value clean, maintainable code and continuously refactor to keep designs simple and scalable.
Motivated by the challenge: You're curious and energized by complex problem-solving rather than just shipping features quickly. You thrive in environments with fast iterations and careful design, where understanding the problem deeply is valued over rushing to delivery. Collaborative mindset: You communicate respectfully, share knowledge openly, and actively support your teammates' growth.

Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 650 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France.
 
Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. title: Fullstack Engineer
description_clean:
About Sparkify

Sparkify is built by Onstruc UG, a Berlin-based documentation-software company founded in 2020. Onstruc started out building photo-based documentation tools for the construction trade broadly; about two and a half years ago, the team began focusing that experience specifically on electricians, teaming up with Wiha — a German tool manufacturer with 80 years of history and a genuine fan following in the trade — to build the NFC-enabled hardware integration that's now Sparkify's core differentiator.
Electricians are legally required to document their work — photos, forms, measurement data — after every job; Sparkify replaces pen-and-paper and Excel-and-a-prayer with something that works fully offline in the field, and turns taking a measurement into a tap by pulling data straight off Wiha's testing devices via NFC.
Live for 120 days, we're already at 85+ clients and roughly 125 seats, adding about one new client a day -well financed, growing, and shipping fast with a small senior team. We are looking for someone to take clear ownership of our web platform now: backend, frontend, and the production reality in between.

About the role 

You take operational ownership of our production system: PHP 8 / Symfony services and a Vue 3 web client used by electricians every day. You keep the system stable, keep billing flowing, and work through a concrete, prioritized bug and feature backlog end to end.
This is a full-stack ownership role in the practical sense: no backend feature is done until the UI exists, and no frontend flow is complete unless the API, data model, and operational behavior behind it work properly.
This is not a greenfield fantasy, but it is not a legacy horror either. It is a clear, manageable production system with real users, real revenue, and real momentum. You will not be alone: our infrastructure partner supports the Couchbase layer, and you will work closely with our founder, who's covering CTO duties directly, so the system becomes better documented and easier to own over time.

 
What You'll Do

Own the Symfony service fleet: API, auth, payment, notification, image, and PDF-report services; Symfony Messenger for async jobs
Own the web client with it: a Vue 3 + Vuetify + TypeScript SPA using Pinia and Vite
Ship features end to end across checkout, billing, workspace, admin, and documentation flows
Build data import/export support as new hardware-manufacturer partners join the platform
Keep billing flowing: Mollie subscriptions, webhooks, invoices, SEPA mandates
Run and improve production infrastructure: Hetzner servers, GitHub Actions CI, SSH deploys, Cloudflare DNS, Pulumi IaC, and observability via Sentry, Datadog, and Grafana
Work through a real backlog: well-defined bugs, missing endpoints, data cleanups, hardening items, and pragmatic product improvements
Get productive with Couchbase and Sync Gateway, which power our mobile sync. Prior Couchbase experience is helpful, but not required; our managed-service partner's Couchbase engineers support us here

 
What you bring  

At least 5 years' full-stack engineering experience with strong PHP/Symfony, comfortable owning production systems and being trusted with them
Genuinely comfortable with complex, nested JSON and document-based data modeling — our core datastore is document-based (Couchbase), not purely relational; Couchbase itself isn't required on day one, but this general comfort is
Solid modern frontend skills; our SPA is Vue 3 + Vuetify + TypeScript, and deep Vue experience is ideal
Strong engineers coming from React, Angular, Svelte, or similar frameworks are welcome if they can become productive in Vue quickly
Comfortable with Git submodules and a modular, multi-service repo structure
Excellent English, spoken and written; it is our working language
Good German is a plus
E-commerce or payments experience, for example Mollie, Stripe, or similar, is a big plus
DevOps-capable: comfortable with Linux servers, DNS, CI/CD, and production debugging
Pulumi/IaC experience is a plus
Pragmatic, direct, and able to ship without turning everything into a grand redesign

 
Compensation and Perks

A friendly environment with a small team of collaborative and innovative people.
Competitive salary and compensation package.
Home-office friendly, with an office culture we are actively building and expect people to take part in regularly — this is remote-first, not remote-only: a weekly in-person day and the team's daily video standup are part of the role, not an occasional nice-to-have.
You will work directly with the founder, with fast decisions and very little process theater. 
We cover your equipment (Mac, phone, and home-office setup), plus a Deutschland-Ticket on top of salary and a supplementary health allowance (~€600/year).

Automatisierung.  Erfahrung in der Datenmodellierung, idealerweise mit Bronze-, Silver- und Gold-Layer-Architekturen.  Kenntnisse im Datenqualitätsmanagement sowie in Monitoring, Logging und Performance-Optimierung.  Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Umsetzung technischer Projekte sowie eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.  Ausgeprägte Teamorientierung sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld.  Fließende Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse. B. mit GitHub Actions oder Azure DevOps.  Interesse an Machine Learning und dem Aufbau datengetriebener Organisationen.  Erfahrung mit Openbridge. Die Rolle als Data Engineer klingt genau nach dir? description_clean:

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Lead, mentor, and grow a team of engineers, creating clarity, strong execution habits, and a healthy engineering culture.
Own the team's roadmap and delivery across core Computing Platform areas such as performance, scaling and resource management, I/O optimization, integrations, developer experience, and observability.

At least 3+ years of solid experience as an engineering manager, including directly leading and growing a team of engineers in a fast-paced environment.

This is an opportunity to lead a foundational platform team working on one of the most important backend building blocks.
